page.overview:
What is Llewebum?

Llewebum was a planet located in the galaxy. It was home to a species of the same name. It was a member of the New Republic.

Jason Fry, co-author of The Essential Atlas, indicated in March 2023 that Llewebum was validated for a future update of The Essential Atlas Online Companion.
